# Polished Insurance

> Specialist insurance broker for UK cleaning businesses. Polished Insurance is a trading name of Allied Insurance Services Ltd, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 309497). Phone 0330 056 8970.

## Insurance for cleaning businesses
- [Contract Cleaners Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/contract-cleaners-insurance): For companies cleaning offices, schools, retail and industrial sites under contract.
- [Commercial & Office Cleaning Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/commercial-cleaning-insurance): For office, shop, gym and commercial premises cleaners.
- [Domestic Cleaners Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/domestic-cleaners-insurance): For self-employed home cleaners and domestic cleaning agencies.
- [Window Cleaners Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/window-cleaners-insurance): For residential and commercial window cleaners, including water-fed pole systems.
- [Carpet & Upholstery Cleaners Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/carpet-cleaners-insurance): For carpet, rug and upholstery cleaning specialists.
- [End of Tenancy Cleaning Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/end-of-tenancy-cleaning-insurance): For end of tenancy, move-in and deep cleaning businesses.
- [Oven Cleaners Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/oven-cleaners-insurance): For oven, range and extractor cleaning specialists and franchisees.
- [Pressure Washing & Driveway Cleaning Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/pressure-washing-insurance): For driveway, patio, render, roof and exterior cleaning.
- [Specialist & Deep Cleaning Insurance](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/specialist-cleaning-insurance): For builders cleans, kitchen extraction, biohazard and industrial cleaning.
- [Public Liability Insurance for Cleaners](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/public-liability-insurance-for-cleaners): Injury to the public and damage to third-party property.
- [Employers' Liability Insurance for Cleaning Companies](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/employers-liability-insurance-for-cleaners): The legal requirement once you employ cleaners.
- [Tools & Equipment Insurance for Cleaners](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/tools-and-equipment-insurance-for-cleaners): Machines, vacuums, pressure washers and pole systems.
- [Loss of Keys Insurance for Cleaners](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/loss-of-keys-insurance): Replacement keys, fobs and locks for client premises.
- [Professional Indemnity for Cleaning & Facilities Companies](https://polished-insurance.com/cleaning-insurance/professional-indemnity-insurance-for-cleaning-companies): For advice, specifications, audits and consultancy.
